children.name: Atrina fragilis
children.description: Atrina fragilis, the fan mussel, is a species of large saltwater clam, a marine bivalve mollusc in the family Pinnidae, the pen shells.

children.name: Atrina pectinata
children.description: Atrina pectinata is a species of bivalves belonging to the family Pinnidae, and has the common names comb pen shell and fan mussel in English.

children.name: Atrina rigida , 1786
children.description: Atrina rigida, commonly called the rigid pen shell, is a species of bivalve mollusc in the family Pinnidae.

children.name: Atrina seminuda
children.description: Atrina seminuda, the half-naked pen shell, is a species of bivalve mollusc in the family Pinnidae.

children.name: Atrina serrata
children.description: Atrina serrata, or saw-toothed pen shell, is a species of bivalve mollusc in the family Pinnidae.

children.name: Atrina squamifera
children.description: Atrina squamifera, one of several species known as the horse mussel, is a species of bivalve pen shell.

children.name: Atrina zelandica
children.description: Atrina zelandica, one of several species known as the horse mussel, is a large species of saltwater clam.

children.name: Pinna nobilis Linnaeus, 1758
children.description: Pinna nobilis, known by the common names noble pen shell and fan mussel, is a large species of Mediterranean clam, a marine bivalve mollusc in the family Pinnidae, the pen shells.
